It doesn't read like other Jedi documentation.|l337b0i, posting on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>}}
A '''text analyzer''' was a tool for performing textual analysis. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[mstrslcr]] distributed on the [[Cularin holonet node]] an intercepted message from an anonymous source that discussed [[Almas Academy]],<ref name="academic review" /> a [[Jedi academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> A [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] user going by the handle "[[l337b0i]]" used a text analyzer to scrutinize the message and observed that the communique was not worded like standard [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Writing/Legends|writing]] and instead consisted of corporate rhetoric.<ref name="academic review" />
